frontmatter.description: Deepen ONE named concept through its mechanism, parts, limits, failure modes, history, primary sources and expert disagreements; repeat measured deepening passes to the stated stop condition. TRIGGER: "/rabbithole", "deepen my understanding of X", "exhaust X completely", "go as deep as possible on X". SKIP: family/domain gaps → concept-family-explorer; one ordinary research pass → dr; extract concept mentions from an existing corpus → llms-txt-tooling (references/llms-concept-abstractor/llms-concept-abstractor.md); reorganize existing skill tree → skill-tree-architect.
frontmatter.name: rabbithole
whenToUse: exhaust <concept> completely — go as deep as you can
give me everything there is to know about <concept>, however deep that goes
keep researching <concept> until another pass finds nothing new
whenNotToUse: the subject is a domain or family, not one concept (use concept-family-explorer)
one ordinary research pass is enough, no exhaustion loop wanted (use /dr)
the concept's mentions already sit inside a corpus you hold and you want them pulled out (use llms-concept-abstractor)
you want the skill tree reorganized, not a concept researched (use skill-tree-architect)
